# 金籙晚朝儀

**ID:** KR5b0173
**Custom ID:** ZB5b0173

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The seventh of the Dù Guāngtíng **Jīnlù** 金籙 cycle ([KR5b0167](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0167)–[KR5b0181](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0181)); the evening audience of the *Jīnlù*-fast daily *cháo* sequence, transmitted with [KR5b0171](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0171) and [KR5b0172](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0172) as 三儀同卷. The opening hymn *Shénguāng lǎngyào* 神光朗曜 ("Divine light shines forth, auspicious vapour wreathes round, the Winnowing-and-Dipper purified in luminance, *zhīyǔ* tranquil; jade-eye and golden-perfected, the treasure-altar pure Qián") is closely parallel to that of [KR5b0156](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0156) *Hóng'ēn Língjì wǎncháo* — evidence that the early-Míng *Língjì* cycle inherited its *cháo* diction from this Tang prototype.

**Abstract**

The evening audience presents the *wǎnzhāng* 晚章 memorial to the celestial bureau at the *yǒu* (5–7 p.m.) hour. Schipper & Verellen (*Taoist Canon* 2: 994–996, entry by John Lagerwey). The text closes with the *yǐnshēng* 引聲 dismissal and the *huíxiàng* dedication of the day's accumulated merit toward the imperial-state purposes of the *Jīnlù* rite.
